warnings: Axes: x = 1-2-3 at 4.00 + 4.00 (8.00); y = A-B-C-D at 3.00 + 4.00 + 2.50 (9.50). Origin A1. The same main chains print on S-01, S-02, S-03, S-04, A-03 and (as sections) A-07/A-08. Vector CAD PDF whose text layer is mis-encoded — every value read off the rendered page.

x 2''' (6.10) is the S-02/S-03/A-03 tick 2.10 + 1.90 between grids 2 and 3 where beam B1 runs. It is 2''' rather than 2' because the Truss T1 chain (S-05) puts 1.000 ticks at 5.00 and 6.00 earlier in the same gap; dummy names follow position order (section 4). 6.00 (2'') and 6.10 (2''') are different points (0.10 apart), both kept.

Truss T1 (S-05) prints 8 x 1.000 panels between 1 and 3, Truss T2 prints 0.833 x3 | 1.000 x4 | 1.000 x3 between D and A; every tick became a line per section 4 rule 4 (x 1''..1'''', 2', 2'', 2''''; y A'', A''', B'..B''', C', C''). The T2 0.833 ticks are positioned off C (7.833, 8.666); 0.833 x3 = 2.499 against the printed 2.50 — a 0.001 drawing rounding, absorbed by the last segment.
Roof eave 1.00 beyond grids 1/3 and rows A/D (S-04 chains) became 1', 3', A', D'.

z: ±0.00 = ระดับถนนภายใน (A-07; A-01 notes say the same). A-08 repeats the same levels on its left edge (lower part checked: 0.64 / +0.64 / ±0.00) and is not entered twice. Truss heights (T1 2.471; T2 0.500 + 1.849 = 2.349) are member-internal and stay on the truss elements (S-05 file), not z ticks. Footing depths 1.00 / 0.50 / 0.05 / 0.05 (S-06) are measured from ระดับดินเดิม and stay on the footing elements.

Dimension sweep covers S-01..S-05, A-03 (floor plan), A-07/A-08 (building sections). Not swept in this op04 (pass2-only) run: A-04 (roof plan), A-05/A-06 (elevations — they repeat the 4.00/4.00 and 3.00/4.00/2.50 rows and the same levels), A-09, A-10 (door/window sizes stay on the schedule elements), E-01, SN-01, SN-02. S-06/S-07 print only member-internal dimensions (section sizes, cap sizes, slab thicknesses), which stay on their elements.
